author: Zyralithic
quote: This is the game I dreamed of as a kid, you can feel all of the passion put into this game in every blade of grass to every drop of water the game is beautiful, I’d like to think this is what they originally wanted if it wasn’t restrained by the 64
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Zyralithic
quote: Played this game for the first time before the remake came out and I have to say it has aged wonderfully, it has some restraints as any game on the n64 would have but with those restrictions they made the grandfather of all 3d video games and plenty of fantasy stories and it’s easy to see why
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Zyralithic
quote: The game didn’t really improve upon anything and I encountered multiple glitches, which would usually be fine, but for a game like this that has been in development for so long and had such a high budget & price I was expecting better than this
